submissions.title: Paper Submission
submissions.comingSoonBody: The submission system is being prepared. Follow the news to know when submissions open.
submissions.rulesBody: The submission rules, thematic areas and schedule are in the call for papers.

open.title: Submissions are open
open.body: Send your paper through the website. You need an account; registering for the event can be done later.

not_open.title: Submissions have not opened yet
not_open.body: You can already create your account. Sending becomes available on the date set in the call.

closed.title: Submissions are closed
closed.body: The deadline has passed. Those who sent a paper can follow it under My papers.

registration.title: Registration
registration.consent: I authorise the use of my data (name, e-mail, CPF or passport) to organise the event and to send me information about registrations, under the Brazilian data protection law (LGPD).
registration.successBody: Your registration was recorded successfully. Payment instructions will be sent by email soon. Follow the event news.
registration.paymentNote: The fee is paid through Mercado Pago right after you submit the form, by card or boleto.

errors.duplicate: A registration with this email already exists for this event.
errors.consent_required: You need to authorise the use of your data to send the registration.
errors.closed: Registration for this event is not open.
errors.duplicateDocument: There is already a registration for this edition with this document, made with the e-mail {{email}}. Log in to your account or contact the organisers.

registration.accountEmailHint: The registration uses the e-mail of your account.
registration.accountCta: To follow your registration and submit papers, create your account with the same e-mail:
registration.goToArea: See my registration in My area

payment.title: Registration payment
payment.intro: To confirm your registration, pay the fee through Mercado Pago.
payment.payLater: If you prefer to pay later, keep this link:

errors.no_fee_available: Payment is not available yet for this category on this date.
errors.payment_pending: A payment for this registration is already being processed. Please wait for the confirmation.
errors.registration_not_found: We could not find this registration. Please check the link.
errors.payment_not_found: We could not find this payment.
errors.invalidLink: This payment link is not valid.
errors.generic: The operation could not be completed. Please try again in a moment.

APPROVED.title: Payment approved!
APPROVED.body: Your registration is confirmed. Thank you!

PENDING.title: Payment being processed
PENDING.body: Mercado Pago is still processing or reviewing the payment, which can take from a few minutes to a few days depending on the payment method. Your registration is confirmed as soon as the payment is. There is no need to pay again: keep the address of this page to follow it.

CREATED.title: Payment not completed
CREATED.body: We have not identified the payment yet. If you have already paid, wait a few minutes and refresh this page.

REJECTED.title: Payment not approved
REJECTED.body: The payment was declined. You can try again with another payment method.

CANCELLED.title: Payment cancelled
CANCELLED.body: This payment was cancelled or expired before it was completed.

REFUNDED.title: Payment refunded
REFUNDED.body: The amount of this payment was refunded.

venue.title: Venue
venue.onlineText: The event is held online, streamed live on the SIEAmB YouTube channel. The link for each session will be published with the programme.

editions.title: Past Editions
editions.archivedBanner: You are browsing the {{event}} archive, a past edition.

myRegistration.title: My Registration
myRegistration.none: You do not have a registration for this event yet.

anais.title: Proceedings

account.sentHint: If the message does not arrive in a few minutes, check your spam folder or ask again.

errors.email_not_confirmed: This e-mail has not been confirmed yet. Use the link we sent, or ask for another one under "Create account".
errors.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.generic: We could not log you in right now. Try again in a moment.

signup.title: Create account
signup.intro: Enter your name and e-mail. We will send a link to confirm the e-mail and choose your password.
signup.sentBody: If {{email}} can have an account, we sent a message with the link to continue.

recover.title: Forgot my password
recover.intro: Enter the e-mail of your account. We will send a link to create a new password.
recover.sentBody: If {{email}} has an account, we sent a message with the link to create the new password.

confirm.title: Create password
confirm.intro: E-mail confirmed. Choose the password of your account.

newPassword.title: New password
newPassword.intro: Choose the new password of your account.

password.label: Password
password.mismatch: The two passwords are not the same.
password.invalidTitle: This link is no longer valid
password.invalidBody: The link was already used or has expired. Ask for another one to continue.

link.title: Confirm registration
link.doneBody: The registration and its payment now show in the account that asked for it.

area.title: My area
area.none: You are not registered for this edition yet.

stateBody.PAID: Payment received. Nothing else to do.
stateBody.PENDING: We received your payment request and are waiting for the confirmation. Boletos can take a few days.
stateBody.UNPAID: The registration is only complete once the fee is paid.
stateBody.CANCELLED: The organisers cancelled this registration. If in doubt, contact the organisers.

area.documentHint: Enter your CPF, or your passport if you have no CPF. Once saved, the document can only be changed by the organisers.
area.documentLockedHint: To correct the document, contact the organisers.
area.suggestionBody: We found a registration for the {{event}} with your document, made with the e-mail {{email}}. Is it yours?
area.noAccess: I no longer have access to that e-mail
area.requestSent: We sent a confirmation link to {{email}}. Open that e-mail and confirm to add the registration to this account.
area.requestOrganiser: Your request was sent to the organisers, who will check it and answer.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
errors.invalid_country: Enter the 2-letter code of the passport country.
errors.weak_password: The password needs at least {{min}} characters and cannot contain your e-mail.
errors.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Wait a little and try again.
errors.not_logged_in: Your session has ended. Log in again.
errors.document_locked: The document was already given and can only be changed by the organisers.
errors.document_in_use: This document is already in another account. If that account is yours, log in with it; if not, contact the organisers.
errors.already_registered: This account already has a registration for this edition.
errors.registration_not_found: We could not find that registration.
errors.link_expired: This link has expired. Ask for another one in My area.
errors.cannot_link: The registration could not be added to that account. Contact the organisers.

papers.title: My papers
papers.none: You have not sent a paper yet, and are not listed as a co-author.
papers.withdrawConfirm: Withdraw this paper? It will not be reviewed.
papers.limits: You have sent {{asMain}} of {{maxAsMain}} papers as main author and are a co-author in {{asCoauthor}} of {{maxAsCoauthor}}.
papers.limitReached: You have already sent the {{maxAsMain}} papers allowed as main author.

window.closed: Submissions closed on {{date}}. Papers can no longer be changed.

registration.none: You are not registered for the event yet. You can register at any time.
registration.noneWithPapers: You are not registered yet. An approved paper only enters the programme if at least one of its authors is registered.
registration.UNPAID: The fee still has to be paid to complete the registration.
registration.PENDING: We are waiting for the payment to be confirmed.
registration.PAID: Nothing else to do about the registration.
registration.CANCELLED: The organisers cancelled this registration. If in doubt, contact the organisers.

form.title: Title in Portuguese
form.keywordsHint: Up to {{max}} in each language, separated by semicolons.
form.coauthorsHint: Up to {{max}} co-authors, in authorship order. You are the main author. Co-authors need neither an account nor a registration for the paper to be sent, and are told by e-mail.
form.fileHint: PDF or Word (.docx), up to {{maxMb}} MB, in the template of the call and with the names of all authors.
form.sendAnyway: It is another paper, send it anyway

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
errors.not_logged_in: Your session has ended. Log in again.
errors.event_not_found: This edition does not take papers through the website.
errors.submission_not_found: We could not find that paper, or it can no longer be changed.
errors.submission_locked: This paper is already under review and can no longer be changed.
errors.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Wait a little and try again.
errors.wrong_file_type: The file must be a PDF or a Word file (.docx).
errors.unreadable_file: The file could not be read. Check that it opens normally and that it really is a PDF or a .docx.
errors.wrong_page_count: The file has {{pages}} pages. For this modality the call asks for {{minPages}} to {{maxPages}}.
errors.invalid_abstract: The abstract needs between 50 and 5000 characters.

errors.invalid_coauthor: Check the name and e-mail of each co-author.
errors.duplicate_author: The e-mail {{email}} appears more than once among the authors.

errors.too_many_as_main: You have already sent the {{max}} papers allowed as main author.
errors.coauthor_limit: {{email}} is already a co-author in {{max}} papers, the limit of the call.
errors.duplicate_title: One of the authors already sent a paper with this title (no. {{number}}). Each paper must be sent only once.
errors.upload_failed: The file could not be sent. Check your connection and try again.

roleDescription.ORGANIZER: Follows registrations and papers, sets reviewers and sends announcements.

papers.noAuthorRegistered: No author has a confirmed registration.

people.invited: This person has no account yet. The role is kept and they were told by e-mail to create the account.

announcements.sent_other: Announcement recorded for {{count}} people. The e-mails go out gradually, in the next minutes.
